Room to grow

First attempts guide your next topic and difficulty. Reviews don’t inflate your score.

Start at foundation level. Two correct answers at the same level move you up; a miss brings the next question down a level. Question level is estimated from its type: warm-ups and sample prompts, regular practice and investigations, then chapter review and extra practice.
